start_frame: Low from the hall floor at kneeling height: her whole body against the 0.38 m opening as she leans in until her forehead is pressed to the door frame, shoulders plainly too wide for it.
end_frame: The same frame after she has pulled back and sat down on her heels, looking from the little door to her own shoulders — the two sizes still both in frame, longing all over her, and not one tear.
constraint_honoured: 'Longing is played with her body, not with tears… The episode cries twice later; nothing is pre-spent here' — the camera stays out of it entirely.
movement_note: Holding the whole 8.0 s in one frame keeps her body and the doorway measurable against each other from first frame to last.
